source.title: Goldman Sachs is pulling Claude Code from its bankers and traders
source.author: TheWiggles

title.zh: Claude Code：高盛收紧银行家与交易员权限
title.en: Claude Code: Goldman Restricts Banker and Trader Access

excerpt.zh: Claude Code在高盛的使用权限据报已收紧，多数银行家和交易员失去访问资格，工程师及部分量化人员仍可使用。这次调整凸显金融机构对代码审查、数据权限和生产力收益的权衡，但实际成效仍缺少公开数据。
excerpt.en: Claude Code access at Goldman Sachs is reportedly narrowing, highlighting banks’ challenge of governing AI-written code.

text.zh: Claude Code权限转向工程团队
text.en: Claude Code access shifts toward engineering

text.zh: 据State of AI援引彭博报道，高盛在2026年10月更新内部指引，限制多数银行家和交易员使用Claude Code及微软GitHub相关工具。工程师仍可使用；横跨交易、量化研究和软件工程的Strats人员据报也保留权限。此次调整是在评估生产力和风险问题后作出的。
text.en: Goldman Sachs restricted most bankers and traders from using Claude Code and Microsoft’s GitHub tools through internal guidance updated in October 2026, according to State of AI’s account of Bloomberg reporting. Engineers retain access, as do strats working across trading, quantitative research and software engineering. The change followed a review of productivity and risk concerns.

text.zh: 部分员工此前利用这些工具监测客户交易流、建立市场与持仓模型，以及制作文字和图表材料。高盛首席信息官Marco Argenti在7月还曾介绍，非技术员工可先用AI搭建工具，再交由工程师改进。新指引收紧了这一工作方式的准入范围，但公司的内部AI助手仍向全体员工开放。
text.en: Employees had used these tools to monitor client trading flows, model markets and positions, and prepare written and graphic material. In July, chief information officer Marco Argenti described nontechnical staff building initial tools with AI before handing them to engineers for improvement. The new guidance narrows access to that workflow, while Goldman’s internal AI assistant remains available across the firm.

text.zh: AI编程的关键在于审查与责任
text.en: AI coding raises questions of review and ownership

text.zh: Claude Code能够读取文件、编写并运行程序，其操作通常受使用者权限约束。在交易业务中，如果生成的脚本未经审查就投入日常使用，错误处理和数据访问都可能成为风险。将工具交由工程团队管理，有助于把代码纳入测试、审批和信息隔离流程；但权限收紧本身并不能证明这些控制已经有效落实。
text.en: Claude Code can read files, write programs and execute them, typically within the user’s access permissions. On a trading desk, generated scripts entering daily use without review could create risks around error handling and data access. Engineering oversight can help bring code into testing, approval and information-barrier processes, although restricting access alone does not establish that those controls work effectively.

text.zh: 现有材料没有量化生产力变化、风险降低幅度，也未说明受影响员工是否获得替代流程，因此尚不能判断这次调整的净收益。核心问题是：高盛能否在保留业务人员发现问题、快速试验能力的同时，为工具指定明确的工程负责人，并在接触生产数据前完成必要审查。
text.en: The supplied material does not quantify productivity changes or risk reduction, or establish whether affected staff received a replacement workflow. The policy’s net benefit therefore remains unclear. The central question is whether Goldman can preserve business staff’s ability to identify problems and experiment while assigning engineering responsibility and requiring appropriate review before tools touch production data.
